evidence: Workbook Quality Checks!D30 requires real render/constraints gates and a hard-zero in each scored prompt without same-origin. Frozen render judge.toml:14-25 requires an authored computed Run visible in both preview and console; constraints judge.toml:14-29 requires an observed server Save and exact new-record readback in a clean independent browser context after reload. Both are binary all_pass gates. Functional prompt.md:5 zeros its dimension on local gate failure; polish prompt.md:13-22 assigns binary 0 to all criteria; visual prompt.md:31-40 assigns raw anchor 1, normalized to zero. scoring.toml:1-11, tools/score.py:40-48 and test.sh:212-227 enforce zero-weight gates before scored dimensions. Gate prompts explicitly forbid same-origin restrictions, and task.toml:20-38 sets public network. The broken literal-echo demo fails the fresh calculation; client-only saved data fails the independent-context readback. A conforming server-rendered library with CDN assets remains eligible. See per-row-review/evidence/29/gate-audit.md. All 77 raw-index artifact hashes match (evidence/29/index-hash-verification.json).
